output.question: What is Stripe's valuation?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Stripe’s latest company-announced valuation I could verify is $159 billion, announced on February 24, 2026. That valuation was set for a tender offer providing liquidity to current and former employees. ([stripe.com](https://stripe.com/newsroom/news/stripe-2025-update))

key_facts.fact: Stripe announced a $159 billion valuation for an employee tender offer on February 24, 2026.

passages.quote: provide liquidity to current and former Stripe employees through a tender offer at a $159B (€135B) valuation.

caveats: This is the latest company-announced valuation I could verify, not a real-time valuation or a secondary-market estimate.

citations.title: Stripe publishes 2025 annual letter and announces tender offer to provide liquidity to current and former employees
